title: Eran warns against aid fixers after NBI arrest

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu City Councilor Harry Eran has urged residents to refuse payment to anyone claiming they can expedite government aid following the arrest of a man accused of collecting money from families by posing as an aide to government officials. Eran made the appeal in a draft resolution he crafted following the National Bureau of Investigation-Cebu District Office’s (NBI-CEBDO) arrest of Christian De Asis on Oct. 14. De Asis allegedly posed as a government employee and collected money in exchange for assistance with medical aid, scholarships, and bail for persons deprived of liberty.
